Review by Dr. Hukam Singh Sandu on Hotel Tara Palace, Daryaganj

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Hotel Tara Palace in Daryaganj with my best friend, and the experience was truly commendable. From the moment we arrived, the staff was warm and welcoming, ensuring a smooth check-in process. The rooms were well-maintained, clean, and comfortable, offering a peaceful ambiance perfect for relaxation. The hotel’s location is ideal, with easy access to nearby historical sites and markets.

One of the highlights of our stay was our meeting with the hotel owner, who was incredibly hospitable and passionate about providing quality service. He personally ensured that our needs were met and even shared insights about the hotel’s commitment to guest satisfaction. The food quality was excellent, with a variety of delicious and hygienic options available.

The overall atmosphere was pleasant, and the services exceeded our expectations. Whether for business or leisure, Hotel Tara Palace is a great choice for anyone visiting Daryaganj. I would highly recommend this hotel for its exceptional hospitality, cleanliness, and affordability. Looking forward to visiting again!

negative_snippets:
Room is spacious and washroom is also clean. Service was also good except wifi and hot water. You had to call them everytime so they would switch on the geyser. I had to completely rely on my phones internet as the router in our floor was not working and was not fixed throughout the entire duration of stay.
Also the reception is in first floor so they have configured the elevator to stop in first floor every time the elevator goes up or down. Your room is on second floor and you are alone in the elevator and you board from ground floor, still the elevator will stop in first floor by default then continue from there to second floor.
Location is bit strange as both the main roads leading to the hotel gets barricaded in the evening, as early as 7pm and you would need to walk frkm there to the hotel and the lanes are dimly lit. Hotel is inside an apartment complex, and although it is close to the main road, but due to barricades it would take you more than 5 mins of walking to reach any commute. Due to barricading you cannot find any autos near the hotel and also you cant call cab directly to your hotel neither will they be able to drop you at thr hotels gate.
Overall suggestion isn to avoid at this price point.
